system.description:
Scout-Nin Keyword: Specialized

When you summon two or more Bunshin and are within 60 feet of terrain that could obscure them that you can see, that can hold them you can spend 1 Superiority Die to make a Stealth check vs the highest hostile creatures passive perception, adding the superiority die to the result. On a success, your Bunshin are undetected.
